trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks itself the moment you earn the other 54 trophies, so there is nothing to do here directly — work through the roadmap in order: story first, then stranger strands, activities, collectibles, and 100% completion last. This is the trophy that ends the hunt.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the first story mission of the game, so this trophy is unmissable. It pops when the mission ends and the story moves on.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies sometimes pop a beat late, as the next chapter loads in, so keep playing if it does not fire the instant the final mission ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Pure story progression — unmissable as long as you play the story through to its end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Story progression only — just keep working through the mission list and it will pop at the chapter's close.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Story progression only — the penultimate chapter trophy, earned by playing the story through.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This is the gold story finale — finish the last mission and the trophy pops as the credits roll.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends; like every story mission, it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Play the heist through to its conclusion and the trophy fires at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Finish the mission and the trophy pops — no extra objective needed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Finish the mission and the trophy pops — this one ties into the airport set piece, so expect a big action sequence.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every story mission, stranger strand, activity, collectible set and challenge the game counts toward the checklist. Open the in-game stats to see what is still missing. For most players this is the last trophy before the platinum, so treat it as the endgame — clean up the remaining categories one by one.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, airtime and other stunt moments the game tracks. They stack up across free roam, so drive hard, hit ramps and jumps whenever you see them, and check the stats page for your running total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, racing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling and the rest of the activity list. One attempt at each is enough — you do not need to win anything, so just sample everything the map offers.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's scoring and target layout, use the weapon the challenge asks for, and replay any challenge until it turns gold. This is one of the longest grinds on the list, so chip away at it between story missions.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 in total. Learn each course's racing line, cut corners wherever the drone allows it, and replay locations until you have a win at each one.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 different events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race list across Leonida, switching vehicle types as the events demand.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take the challenge when it is offered, pick bait that suits the spot, watch your timing on the reel, and out-fish Cal's score.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game: play a full game at any arcade cabinet through to its end. Any cabinet counts — pick the shortest game if you just want the trophy quickly.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Stranger missions show up as you explore Leonida — follow Andy's strand through to its last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Follow Kenton's strand to its last mission; stranger strands stay available after the story ends, so there is no rush.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Follow Billy's strand through to its last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than eight strands in the game, so pick any eight and finish each one — the stranger finales for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret all count toward it.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Follow Randy's strand through to its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Follow Tyrone's strand through to its last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY ON THE LIST: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (the morning after 'Down to Earth') may disappear once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay — do it during Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save as backup. Note that the 100% checklist needs only 15 of the 18 meditation spots, so whether this trophy needs all 18 is still unconfirmed at launch.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's stranger strand until the hunt is offered; the target is one specific rare animal — follow the tracking prompts, move quietly, and take it down cleanly.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are tucked away across Leonida; you need three full sets, not every card in the game, so focus on the sets you are closest to finishing first.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Find WAiNK photo spots across the map — 100 of them. Work region by region so you do not lose track, and watch your counter as you go.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more; any 50 count, so knock out the easiest ones first and check the challenges menu to see your progress.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build four stars while your partner is beside you, then break line of sight and hide — a parking garage, an alley, a tunnel or a quiet stretch of countryside all work — until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route of three nearby shops, rob each one in turn, and keep the heat on between them — if the wanted level drops, the chain resets and you start over.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter new vehicle models; each new model counts once. Mix up what you drive — traffic, parked cars and mission vehicles all count toward the total.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a firefight where at least five enemies are grouped together, and drop five of them before the focus runs out. A busy shootout or a mission with waves of enemies is the easiest place to set this up.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal a plane — or otherwise leave the airport by an unplanned route — and expect a wanted response on the way out.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and survive the heat — the description jokes 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' Steal a Rhino (from a military area, or once your wanted level is high enough) and stay alive in it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, nobody spotting you — grab the goods and get out clean. If you are spotted, back out and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Plan each vault job, crack the vault, grab the cash and lose the cops — five times in total.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the cops that respond.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Visit every named region and district until the map is filled in; fly or drive the edges of the map to catch the last few areas.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — all 9 gangs. Find each gang's illegal operation on the map and hit one per gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — a quiet-moment trophy. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed at launch, so check the linked guides as players map it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's glass front and out the other side. The exact showroom and trigger are still unconfirmed at launch, so check the linked guides as players map it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game at that alley — the trophy is about the follow-through, so finish the game rather than quitting halfway.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is about your partnership — build its appeal together with your partner. The exact trigger is unconfirmed at launch, so check the linked guides as players map it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). A story-choice trophy: make the key choices as the story offers them. It is hidden, so the exact choice is unconfirmed — it pops through story play, so just keep making decisions as they come.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Retry something after failing once — the wording points to a second attempt succeeding where the first one failed. The exact trigger is unconfirmed at launch, so check the linked guides as players map it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden moment — a secret encounter or strange event somewhere in Leonida. The exact trigger is unconfirmed at launch, so check the linked guides as players map it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, knock down bowling pins with a melee attack from the vehicle — line the car up with the pins, swing as you pass, and watch them scatter.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Collect Marked Bills from jobs and launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean — it adds up over a full playthrough, so keep laundering as the bills come in.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, food and more — spending accumulates across every shop, so this comes naturally over a full playthrough. If you are close, a weapon or wardrobe splurge finishes it off.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — all 8 of them. Buy every garage property on the market; save up first, as properties are one of the biggest spends on this list.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the app to register ten different vehicles you own or find — any ten count, so register as you go.

meta.note: Names, descriptions and grades verbatim from the kit starter list, which the kit states matches Exophase and PSNProfiles; checked 2026-11-19 against 5 tracker/guide sources. The Chapter 2 trophy keeps the kit's censored spelling 'T**s Ass Drug Money' because the gate matches that exact name. Guides are original text written for this entry; sources are cited, never copied. Unconfirmed-at-launch triggers are flagged honestly in the guides instead of invented.
